title: Rooftop Fighting Foundation
description: Original shared-screen 1P CPU or 2P fighting game with independent character selection, frame-based attacks, animated characters, guard levels, air attacks, meter specials, hitstop, score, timed best-of-three rounds and rooftop art. Includes complete original Batman and Flash fan-art animation sets; additional identities require explicit complete assets.

license.notes: Original authored implementation and pixel artwork. Batman and The Flash fan-art depicts DC characters; this provenance grants no rights to those underlying characters or trademarks. No commercial game code, sprites, ROM data, or sprite sheets were copied.

quality.notes: Behavior and isolated browser evidence included; admission requires content-hash-bound quality review.
